X-axis homing fails is most likely caused by the cables leading from the print head to the extruder getting in the way. Ensure that the cables have sufficient leeway and are not blocking the print head from reaching the end of the X-axis. Additionally, check that the cables and PTFE tube leading to the extruder are not touching anything and that there are no blockages in the axes.
